properties.description: Migrated from DataStage Server Job 'CopyOfCopyOfJ990_Jen_Extraccion_IB' (DateModified: 2025-03-28). HARDCODED DATE RANGE VARIANT. Source: journal.dbo.jen. Filter uses a FIXED 7-day range (2025-03-14 to 2025-03-21 in the original) instead of a parameter. MANUAL ACTION REQUIRED: Replace hardcoded dates with parameters before production use. Original SqlWhere: CAST(jen_fec_evt_neg AS DATE)>=dateadd(day,-7,CAST('2025-03-14' AS DATE)) AND CAST(jen_fec_evt_neg AS DATE)<=dateadd(day,-7,CAST('2025-03-21' AS DATE)) AND SUBSTRING(jen_ope_evt,1,2)='IB'

activities.name: ExecuteDataFlow_Trf_Jen_7dias
activities.description: Replicates DataStage flow with hardcoded date range filter for 7-day window. Dates parameterized here for flexibility.

query.value: SELECT jen_ope_evt, jen_fec_evt_neg, jen_fec_ctb_evt, jen_rut_cli, jen_vrf_cli, jen_rut_emp, jen_vrf_emp, jen_id_cnl, jen_est_cnl, jen_suc_ori, jen_med, jen_id_med, jen_tip_opr_bci, jen_id_opr, jen_mod_tar, jen_fra_lin, jen_ara_cua, jen_id_svs, jen_est_evt_neg, jen_id_pdt, jen_id_evt, jen_id_sub_evt, jen_clv_ppl, jen_mto, jen_clv_sgd, jen_cpo_var FROM @{pipeline().parameters.DBO_Journal}.jen WHERE CAST(jen_fec_evt_neg AS DATE) >= DATEADD(day, -7, CAST('@{pipeline().parameters.FechaDesde}' AS DATE)) AND CAST(jen_fec_evt_neg AS DATE) <= DATEADD(day, -7, CAST('@{pipeline().parameters.FechaHasta}' AS DATE)) AND SUBSTRING(jen_ope_evt, 1, 2) = 'IB'

FechaDesde.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. In original DataStage job this was HARDCODED as '2025-03-14'. Parameterized here. Original expression: dateadd(day,-7,CAST('2025-03-14' AS DATE)).

FechaHasta.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD. In original DataStage job this was HARDCODED as '2025-03-21'. Parameterized here. Original expression: dateadd(day,-7,CAST('2025-03-21' AS DATE)).

FechaArchExtraccion.description: File date YYYYMMDD. Maps to DataStage $FechaArchExtraccion.

NombreJob.description: Job name for filename. Maps to DataStage $NombreJob.

annotations: CRITICAL_difference: Uses HARDCODED date range in original DataStage job (2025-03-14 to 2025-03-21). ADF version parameterizes these dates.
